theorems.statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (N W : Set (Euclid P)) (V : Set (Euclid d)) (ψ : Euclid d → Euclid P) (v₀ : Euclid d), IsOpen V → IsOpen W → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ψ V → InjOn ψ V → ψ '' V = W ∩ N → (∀ K ⊆ W, IsCompact K → IsCompact (V ∩ ψ ⁻¹' K)) → (∀ z ∈ V, Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ z)) → v₀ ∈ V → ∃ (r δ : ℝ) (g : Euclid P → Euclid d), 0 < r ∧ 0 < δ ∧ closedBall v₀ δ ⊆ V ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 g (ball (ψ v₀) r) ∧ MapsTo g (ball (ψ v₀) r) (ball v₀ δ) ∧ (∀ x ∈ ball (ψ v₀) r, ∀ z ∈ N, ‖x - ψ (g x)‖ ≤ ‖x - z‖) ∧ (∀ x ∈ ball (ψ v₀) r, (fderiv ℝ ψ (g x)).range.starProjection (x - ψ (g x)) = 0) ∧ ∀ x ∈ N ∩ ball (ψ v₀) r, ψ (g x) = x
